title: Fix draft release asset verification
outOfScope: External provider publication or release mutation
Deleting, moving, or modifying the immutable v0.5.44 tag or Draft Release

sources.reason: The failed v0.5.44 release workflow downloaded a Draft Release by tag before publication.
Regression coverage for release workflow ordering and commands.
Authoritative provider evidence: Draft assets exist, but the tagged Quick Install verification fails with no assets matching the pattern.

riskAssessment.reason: A release tag is immutable once created; the correction must preserve the Draft-before-publication safety boundary and prove the asset verification path.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized continuous corrective Work Items. This item changes the pre-publication workflow only; no provider publication occurs in this item.

preReviewWarnings: Review Draft Release asset access separately from public tagged download behavior; reject any change that publishes before Quick Install verification.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The release workflow verifies the Draft Release's uploaded archive and projected metadata before publication without relying on a public tagged asset URL.
The workflow still validates the public tag URL and performs the real public Quick Install only after the Draft is published.
A regression test proves the Draft verification uses an access path supported for Draft assets and does not make release publication occur earlier.
The immutable failed v0.5.44 tag and Draft Release are not mutated, deleted, or republished by this Work Item.
The process failure and corrective boundary are recorded in the execution plan.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed release behavior and immutable tag boundaries.
Keep the fix scoped to the provider workflow and its deterministic regression coverage.
Do not claim v0.5.44 is publicly released; use a new patch release only after the correction lifecycle closes.

intent.problem: The v0.5.44 workflow created its immutable tag and Draft Release successfully, but failed before publication because `gh release download v0.5.44` cannot select assets from the Draft Release by tag. The release has uploaded evidence assets but remains a Draft.
constraints: Do not mutate, delete, or re-publish v0.5.44 or its Draft Release.
Keep the release Draft until verification succeeds; do not weaken the Quick Install gate.
Use a new patch tag for the eventual corrective public release.
Record all process failures in the plan.
intent.rationale: Draft asset validation must use an authenticated Draft-supported selector or the local generated files, while public tagged Quick Install remains a post-publication external check. This removes the impossible Draft-by-tag download assumption without bypassing evidence validation.

rawUserRequest: Continue the complete serial Work Item process. Record process failures, repair the release workflow without modifying immutable failed tags, and continue until the documented plan is fully completed.
